title: GEOMAPS: controlled vector-tile granularity with MVT and Rust MLT v1/v2 — software
description: Code for “Does Tile Granularity Matter?”. Five variants separate exact Standard-feature aggregation (Aggregated-4/16) from regenerated Dense-4/16 tiles. One pinned official Rust mlt-core source from maplibre-tiles 0.4.1 encodes MLT v1/v2. Includes source-feature provenance, typed multiset validation, matched-block additive byte decomposition, stream analysis and automatic manuscript/figure generation. Historical Python-produced results remain separate. The earlier dataset is at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23452598; expanded results are generated locally pending a new release.
